words.name: Word index
words.description: One list of the words you know, are learning or ignore, built from all your cards and marks. Reading mode and the Subtitle extension use it.

language.label: Language of the cards
language.description: Which language the words on these cards are in (e.g. en). Set it per deck; empty means unknown and those cards do not count as words.

known_interval_days.label: Days until a word counts as known
known_interval_days.description: A word whose card waits at least this many days between reviews counts as known. A word you marked yourself keeps your mark.
